title: Foundation Scenario Context (C033)
description: Minimum scenario identity carried by every public contract. This is a draft implementation schema, not a final platform contract.

x-field-owners.status: Foundation (scenario owner may define lifecycle values)

scenarioId.description: Stable scenario identity; must be shared by the version and run identifiers.

scenarioVersion.description: Scenario definition/version identifier, normally prefixed by scenarioId (for example S001-v1).

scenarioRunId.description: Unique execution/round identifier, normally prefixed by scenarioId.

formedAt.description: UTC time at which this context was formed.

status.description: Lifecycle status owned by the scenario/run owner.
